# RK Vridhi Digital

> RK Vridhi Digital is an independent digital marketing strategist and AI-powered growth consultant practice run by Rakesh Kumar, based in Chandigarh, India, serving clients in India, USA, UAE, Australia, Canada and Europe. It is a solo consulting practice, not a multi-person agency — clients work directly with Rakesh Kumar.

## Who

Rakesh Kumar — Digital Marketing Strategist / AI-Powered Growth Strategist / Customer Acquisition & Conversion System Architect. Builds complete business growth systems: business analysis, market research, strategy, execution, measurement and continuous optimisation — rather than running isolated marketing tactics.

## Services

- Meta Ads and Google Ads management
- YouTube channel management and YouTube SEO
- LinkedIn profile optimisation and LinkedIn B2B lead generation
- SEO (basic and advanced), AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)
- Sales funnels, WhatsApp-based marketing automation and CRM follow-up systems
- Ad creative design and short-form video
- Social media management
- Business growth strategy and consulting

## Industries served

Healthcare, e-commerce, FMCG/D2C, real estate, coaching/consulting, fitness, education, and local businesses.
